items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: when I had met Buddy maybe about five or six years before he died

ctx.x: I heard him even a couple years ago. He was still there.
Well I mean he was on the street with me. And at that time when I had met Buddy maybe about five or six years before he died. And when he really was playing all that trumpet and stuff like that.

What style did he play? I mean can you describe it? I mean I know you can't go into great detail without actually playing the part and trumpet. I mean did he use much mute work like Chris Kelly or was it mostly open?
